entries.summary: Insights splits into Quotas and Usage: every quota account shows all its windows with pace, burn rate, budget and forecast, and opens a detail with its reset schedule and actions.

announcement.title: Insights, rebuilt
announcement.description: Every quota window with pace and forecast, usage charts and a compact summary, each on its own tab.

entries.summary: Insights charts daily tokens, cost or sessions over the whole period, plus sessions by weekday and by hour.
Insights totals sit in a compact two-column summary, and each model row shows its share, cost, tokens, sessions and cache hit rate.
Insights gains a Quotas tab listing every provider account with its windows, pace, burn rate, budget and forecast, and a Usage tab for analytics.
Insights charts gained a baseline, labels, hover values, a metric switch and a table view; the models table shows input, output, total tokens, cache hit rate and share.
The Insights models table no longer shows zero tokens for every model.
